# stacklet_anthropic_integration (Resource)

Manage an Anthropic integration, which imports the daily cost and usage of one Anthropic organization.

The admin key is checked against Anthropic when it is saved: one that doesn't authenticate, or belongs to another organization, fails the apply with the reason, and isn't stored.

There is one integration per organization. Creating this resource for an organization that already has an integration takes that integration over, replacing its admin key.

The admin key is write-only: it is sent to the API and never returned by it, so it isn't kept in Terraform state, and is sent only when admin_key_wo_version changes. The configured attribute reports whether the API holds one.

An import brings in the integration but not the key version, for the same reason. The first apply after an import therefore sends whatever admin_key_wo holds, replacing the stored key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Anthropic only shows an admin key when it is created, so read it from
# somewhere it can be fetched again rather than from Terraform state.
variable "anthropic_admin_key" {
  description = "Anthropic Admin API key for the organization."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "stacklet_anthropic_integration" "example" {
  org_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

  # To rotate the key, change the value and bump its version.
  admin_key_wo         = var.anthropic_admin_key
  admin_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `admin_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) An Anthropic Admin API key for the organization. Anthropic only shows an admin key when it is created, so keep it somewhere it can be read from, such as a secrets manager.
- `admin_key_wo_version` (String) The version for the admin key. Must be changed to update admin_key_wo.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Anthropic organization, as shown in the Claude Console's organization settings. The admin key must belong to it. Changing it replaces the integration.

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the API holds an admin key. This is how to tell, since the key is never returned.
- `id` (String) The GraphQL Node ID of the Anthropic integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stacklet_anthropic_integration.example
  id = "$org_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stacklet_anthropic_integration.example $org_id
```
